question: Which of the following Fundamental Rights is available for Indians as well as foreigners?

options.text: Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions
Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment
Right to protection of language, script and culture of minorities

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Right to elementary education**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Right to Elementary Education (Article 21A)** is a Fundamental Right guaranteed to all persons in India, **including both Indian citizens and foreigners.**
